:::{#def-training-set}
#### Training set

A **training set** is the data
to which a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) is applied:
$n$ observations,
written as an ordered list indexed by a set $I$ of $n$ observation numbers:

$$
\trainset \eqdef \paren{(x_i, y_i)}_{i \in I}, \quad \abs{I} = n.
$$ {#eq-training-set}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.2], who also write the training set as $\mathcal{T}$.
:::
